note: One path-filter list for every CI lane. A lane's push filter is the shared list, or a declared narrowing of it, plus its own extras, its workflow file and the shared actions. Every top-level code root is either in the shared list or excluded here with a reason (scripts/ci/path-filters.ts checks both). Concurrency: group '<lane>-${{ github.ref }}', cancel-in-progress false (AGENTS.md: CI is newest-only; a pending run is replaced by a newer push, a running one finishes; publish and deploy are never cancelled). Caches: dependencies keyed by the lockfile hash, immutable runtime and model assets by their manifest digest; never by branch, ref, run or date.

excluded.autoresearch: research code and records; the research lanes add their maintained paths as extras
excluded.tools: development tools with their own workflows (device lab, names generator and spike, decode measure)
excluded.ops: dashboards, lease and swarm documentation; the lease code is autoresearch/lease.py
excluded..github: workflows are added per lane (its own file) and the shared actions are in the shared list
